description.description: The new description as Markdown source; replaces the whole text, empty clears it. Raw HTML is stripped.
description.title: Description

conductor.description: UUID of an active conductor of the ticket’s project.
conductor.title: Conductor

assignee.description: UUID of the user to assign, when they may be assigned in the ticket’s workspace; empty clears the assignee. The conductor is kept.
assignee.title: Assignee

labels_add.description: Label names to add, e.g. agent:claude; created in the ticket’s workspace when missing and allowed. Existing labels are kept.
labels_add.title: Labels to add

labels_remove.description: Label names to remove; names the ticket does not carry are ignored. Every other label is kept.
labels_remove.title: Labels to remove

frozen.description: TRUE freezes the ticket for a release batch, FALSE unfreezes it.
frozen.title: Frozen

environments_add.description: Names or UUIDs of environments of the ticket’s project, e.g. the deployment target. Existing environments are kept.
environments_add.title: Environments to add

referenced_tickets_add.description: Identifiers or UUIDs of readable tickets, e.g. a deployment’s batch. Existing references are kept.
referenced_tickets_add.title: Referenced tickets to add

reviewers_add.description: Reviewer user UUIDs to add; other reviewers stay. Omitted, null and empty lists change nothing.
reviewers_add.title: Reviewers to add

reviewers_remove.description: Reviewer user UUIDs to remove; other reviewers stay. Omitted, null and empty lists change nothing.
reviewers_remove.title: Reviewers to remove

links_add.description: Links to add or retitle by exact URI. Omitted title keeps it; empty title clears it. Other links stay.

uri.description: The link target, e.g. a merge request URL.
uri.title: URI

links_add.title: Links

links_remove.description: Exact URIs to remove; absent URIs and empty lists change nothing.
links_remove.title: Links to remove

blocked_by_add.description: Identifiers or UUIDs of readable, open tickets of the same project this ticket waits for. Existing blockers are kept; a refused blocker refuses the whole call.
blocked_by_add.title: Blockers to add

blocked_by_remove.description: Identifiers or UUIDs of blockers to remove; tickets that are not blockers are ignored. Every other blocker is kept.
blocked_by_remove.title: Blockers to remove
